sloka: इति सञ्चिन्त्य हनुमांस्तदा प्लवगसत्तमः ।दर्शयामास वैदेह्याः स्वरूपमरिमर्दनः ।। ५.३७.३३।।।।
transliteration: iti sañcintya hanumāṁstadā plavagasattamaḥ ।darśayāmāsa vaidehyāḥ svarūpamarimardanaḥ ।। 5.37.33।।।।

translations.english: 'Blackeyed Sita is not aware of my strength or my power. Therefore let her see the real (huge) form that I can assume at my free will'.
